entries.reason: HealthKit arrived in iOS 8.0 and this release, iOS 6.1.3, has none of it: the armv7 shared cache of 6.1.3 and the one of 4.3 hold no HealthKit image and neither exports a name of it (measured: no string of either cache is HealthKit, with NSObject and PassKit as the controls that say the probe finds what is there). The store is this port's own SQLite database, not Apple's, so the class is carried whole. a CDA document: the data, the title and the three names it is about
entries.effect: each kept as it was given and read back as it was given, a nil stays a nil, and two documents are equal when their data and their four names are. NSSecureCoding and NSCopying carry the data and the four names
